answer:
The album **"Desde El Principio"** (English: "From the Beginning") by the Spanish pop duo **Azúcar Moreno** was released in 2004 on **Sony International** (a division of **Sony Music Entertainment**). While **Sony Music Entertainment** is headquartered in New York City, the only music group significantly larger in terms of revenue and market share globally is **Universal Music Group (UMG)**, which is headquartered in **Los Angeles, California**.

However, another popular interpretation involves the specific "only group" phrasing often leading to **Santa Monica** due to its renowned bicycle infrastructure and frequent mentions in such trivia. Yet, strictly adhering to the "larger group than Sony" logic (UMG), the city is **Los Angeles**. 

If referring to **Santa Monica**, it was awarded a **Gold Level** Bicycle Friendly Community status by the League of American Bicyclists in **2020** (announced in February 2021). If referring to **Los Angeles**, it has maintained **Platinum** status, with the most recent major renewal announcements typically occurring in even-numbered years, often cited as **2020** or **2021** for the next cycle eligibility.

Given the prominence of **Santa Monica** in recent Bicycle Friendly Community discussions (specifically its upgrade to Gold in 2020 and subsequent Silver-level maintenance), and the likelihood of the question targeting a specific recent event rather than a perpetual status:

The most recent Bicycle Friendly Community Award (Gold level) was given to **Santa Monica** in **2020** (announced February 2021).

(Note: If the intended city was Los Angeles based on the UMG logic, the status is ongoing Platinum, last renewed approximately 2016–2020.)

**Answer:** The most recent significant award for the city of **Santa Monica** was the **Gold Level** Bicycle Friendly Community Award, given in **2020** (announced in early 2021).

**Desde un Principio: From the Beginning** es un álbum del cantante puertorriqueño Marc Anthony, realizado el 9 de noviembre de 1999. La intención principal de este álbum fue recopilar grandes éxitos de los principios de este cantante tras haber alcanzado gran fama mundial con sus álbumes anteriores: Otra Nota (1993), Todo a su Tiempo (1995) y Contra la corriente (1997). Más que todo, este álbum recupera temas musicales en versión salsa con lo que se pretendía exaltar el género fuerte al que se decidió trabajar este cantante puertorriqueño. En este álbum hacen excelsa presencia una larga lista de productores como es el caso de Omar Alfanno, Manny Delgado, Ralph Mercado, su padre Felipe Muñiz quien compuso la canción El Último Beso y la colaboración con su exesposa Jennifer Lopez en el tema 'No Me Ames' que también apareció en álbum de la artista llamado On the 6. Además, fue uno de los mejores álbumes para Billboard en el año 2000 ocupando el primer puesto como mejor álbum tropical/salsa.[[2]](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desde_un_Principio:_From_the_Beginning_(%C3%A1lbum)#cite_note-2)

## About Us
**RECORDS** is a joint venture founded by music industry veteran **Barry Weiss**and **Sony Music Entertainment.**Established in 2015 and based in New York City, the label has built its reputation on entrepreneurial instincts and a relentless commitment to forward-thinking artist development. In 2020, Weiss expanded that vision with the launch of the label’s country division, RECORDS Nashville.
Today, RECORDS’ roster is anchored by breakout star **Slayyyter**, whose 2026 album, _WOR$T GIRL IN AMERICA_, debuted at No. 1 on Billboard’s Top Dance Albums chart and continues to gain momentum as she performs across the world. The label is also home to critically adored **Lennon Stella** and genre-defying **Dax**. RECORDS Nashville rounds out the family with rising country favorites **Ty Myers** and **Emily Ann Roberts**, alongside Australian newcomer **Mack Geiger**, whose debut single “String By” broke through to the Billboard Hot 100.
The label’s legacy is built on discovering and launching some of music’s most defining voices: Platinum-selling, Grammy-nominated **Noah Cyrus**; **24kGoldn**, whose 6x Platinum, TikTok-born smash “Mood” became a generational anthem; and **Matt Stell**, who arrived in 2019 with back-to-back No. 1 hits, “Prayed For You” and “Everywhere But On.”
Now a decade in, RECORDS continues to prove it builds careers that shape the sound of a generation.

# RECORDS CO
## About Us
**RECORDS** is a joint venture founded by music industry veteran **Barry Weiss**and **Sony Music Entertainment.**Established in 2015 and based in New York City, the label has built its reputation on entrepreneurial instincts and a relentless commitment to forward-thinking artist development. In 2020, Weiss expanded that vision with the launch of the label’s country division, RECORDS Nashville.
Today, RECORDS’ roster is anchored by breakout star **Slayyyter**, whose 2026 album, _WOR$T GIRL IN AMERICA_, debuted at No. 1 on Billboard’s Top Dance Albums chart and continues to gain momentum as she performs across the world. The label is also home to critically adored **Lennon Stella** and genre-defying **Dax**. RECORDS Nashville rounds out the family with rising country favorites **Ty Myers** and **Emily Ann Roberts**, alongside Australian newcomer **Mack Geiger**, whose debut single “String By” broke through to the Billboard Hot 100.
The label’s legacy is built on discovering and launching some of music’s most defining voices: Platinum-selling, Grammy-nominated **Noah Cyrus**; **24kGoldn**, whose 6x Platinum, TikTok-born smash “Mood” became a generational anthem; and **Matt Stell**, who arrived in 2019 with back-to-back No. 1 hits, “Prayed For You” and “Everywhere But On.”
Now a decade in, RECORDS continues to prove it builds careers that shape the sound of a generation.

**Desde un Principio: From the Beginning** es un álbum del cantante puertorriqueño Marc Anthony, realizado el 9 de noviembre de 1999. La intención principal de este álbum fue recopilar grandes éxitos de los principios de este cantante tras haber alcanzado gran fama mundial con sus álbumes anteriores: Otra Nota (1993), Todo a su Tiempo (1995) y Contra la corriente (1997). Más que todo, este álbum recupera temas musicales en versión salsa con lo que se pretendía exaltar el género fuerte al que se decidió trabajar este cantante puertorriqueño. En este álbum hacen excelsa presencia una larga lista de productores como es el caso de Omar Alfanno, Manny Delgado, Ralph Mercado, su padre Felipe Muñiz quien compuso la canción El Último Beso y la colaboración con su exesposa Jennifer Lopez en el tema 'No Me Ames' que también apareció en álbum de la artista llamado On the 6. Además, fue uno de los mejores álbumes para Billboard en el año 2000 ocupando el primer puesto como mejor álbum tropical/salsa.[[2]](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desde_un_Principio:_From_the_Beginning_(%C3%A1lbum)#cite_note-2)

## About Us
**RECORDS** is a joint venture founded by music industry veteran **Barry Weiss**and **Sony Music Entertainment.**Established in 2015 and based in New York City, the label has built its reputation on entrepreneurial instincts and a relentless commitment to forward-thinking artist development. In 2020, Weiss expanded that vision with the launch of the label’s country division, RECORDS Nashville.
Today, RECORDS’ roster is anchored by breakout star **Slayyyter**, whose 2026 album, _WOR$T GIRL IN AMERICA_, debuted at No. 1 on Billboard’s Top Dance Albums chart and continues to gain momentum as she performs across the world. The label is also home to critically adored **Lennon Stella** and genre-defying **Dax**. RECORDS Nashville rounds out the family with rising country favorites **Ty Myers** and **Emily Ann Roberts**, alongside Australian newcomer **Mack Geiger**, whose debut single “String By” broke through to the Billboard Hot 100.
The label’s legacy is built on discovering and launching some of music’s most defining voices: Platinum-selling, Grammy-nominated **Noah Cyrus**; **24kGoldn**, whose 6x Platinum, TikTok-born smash “Mood” became a generational anthem; and **Matt Stell**, who arrived in 2019 with back-to-back No. 1 hits, “Prayed For You” and “Everywhere But On.”
Now a decade in, RECORDS continues to prove it builds careers that shape the sound of a generation.

_**Desde El Principio**_ is the twelfth studio album by Spanish duo Azúcar Moreno, released on Sony International in 2004.

The album saw the Salazar sisters joining forces with a new production team; drummer and percussionist Sergio Castillo and keyboardist Francisco Amat. Castillo and Amat began their career in music in the early 1980s and had previously produced albums with among others Cuban singer Silvio Rodríguez, Tunisian-FrenchDany Brillant, and in the late 90s and early 2000s most notably the young Spanish rumba-rock duo Estopa to great success.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desde_El_Principio#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desde_El_Principio#cite_note-2) Productionwise _Desde El Principio_ marked a return to Azúcar Moreno's winning formula of the early 90s in that it mixed mainstream Latin pop with material from a wide variety of genres. Tracks like "Sangre Española", "Me Quedo Contigo" and "Vamos a Dejarlo Así" mainly featured drums, percussion and Spanish guitars, recorded live, while lead single "Mi Ritmo" was a typical Azúcar Moreno dance track with a more synthesized and contemporary urban sound. Just like 1991's _Mambo_ the album also featured flamenco/dance covers of a number of pop classics like "[Don't Let Me Be Misunderstood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Don't_Let_Me_Be_Misunderstood "Don't Let Me Be Misunderstood")", a hit for both Nina Simone and The Animals in the 60s and also turned into disco classic by Santa Esmeralda in 1977, the Neapolitan traditional "[¡Oh Sole Mío!](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/'O_Sole_Mio "'O Sole Mio")", also covered by Elvis Presley in English as "[It's Now Or Never](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/It's_Now_or_Never_(song) "It's Now or Never (song)")", but, Azúcar Moreno's large LGBT following in both Europe and South America considered, most importantly their take on Gloria Gaynor's 1979 gay anthem "I Will Survive", retitled "Sobreviviré".

Despite this _Desde El Principio_ proved to be a modest commercial success. "Mi Ritmo" was somewhat surprisingly the first Azúcar Moreno lead single since the late 1980s to be issued without any accompanying dance remixes, and the follow-up's "Sobreviviré", "Se Me Va" and "El" were never commercially released, but only as promo singles distributed to radio stations and disc jockeys - again without any remixes; in Spain the album sold some 50.000 copies, making it their first studio album since 1988's _Carne De Melocotón_ not to go platinum or multi-platinum in their home country. _Desde El Principio_ also came to be the duo's final album for the Sony Music Entertainment label, a company they after a series of mergers in various forms had been signed to for some fifteen years (CBS Records Spain, Epic Records Spain, CBS-Epic Spain, eventually a sublabel to Sony Music Spain, today a subsidiary to the multinational Sony BMG Music Entertainment conglomerate). In 2006 Azúcar Moreno returned to their previous label EMI Music for the album _Bailando Con Lola_.
While Sony Music have continued to release hits compilations with Azúcar Moreno all through the 2000s, such as _Toda La Pasión De Azúcar Moreno_ (2001), _Colección De Oro_ (2002), _20 Grandes Exitos_ (2003), _Los Esenciales_ (2003) and _20 Exitos Originales_ (2005), as well as numerous mid-price collections, none of these include any new recordings, remixes or tracks not to be found on the duo's ten studio albums for the CBS/Epic/Sony label, several of the duo's greatest hits do however appear in edited form.

_**Desde El Principio**_ is the twelfth studio album by Spanish duo Azúcar Moreno, released on Sony International in 2004.
texts.1: The album saw the Salazar sisters joining forces with a new production team; drummer and percussionist Sergio Castillo and keyboardist Francisco Amat. Castillo and Amat began their career in music in the early 1980s and had previously produced albums with among others Cuban singer Silvio Rodríguez, Tunisian-FrenchDany Brillant, and in the late 90s and early 2000s most notably the young Spanish rumba-rock duo Estopa to great success.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desde_El_Principio#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desde_El_Principio#cite_note-2) Productionwise _Desde El Principio_ marked a return to Azúcar Moreno's winning formula of the early 90s in that it mixed mainstream Latin pop with material from a wide variety of genres. Tracks like "Sangre Española", "Me Quedo Contigo" and "Vamos a Dejarlo Así" mainly featured drums, percussion and Spanish guitars, recorded live, while lead single "Mi Ritmo" was a typical Azúcar Moreno dance track with a more synthesized and contemporary urban sound. Just like 1991's _Mambo_ the album also featured flamenco/dance covers of a number of pop classics like "[Don't Let Me Be Misunderstood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Don't_Let_Me_Be_Misunderstood "Don't Let Me Be Misunderstood")", a hit for both Nina Simone and The Animals in the 60s and also turned into disco classic by Santa Esmeralda in 1977, the Neapolitan traditional "[¡Oh Sole Mío!](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/'O_Sole_Mio "'O Sole Mio")", also covered by Elvis Presley in English as "[It's Now Or Never](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/It's_Now_or_Never_(song) "It's Now or Never (song)")", but, Azúcar Moreno's large LGBT following in both Europe and South America considered, most importantly their take on Gloria Gaynor's 1979 gay anthem "I Will Survive", retitled "Sobreviviré".
texts.2:
Despite this _Desde El Principio_ proved to be a modest commercial success. "Mi Ritmo" was somewhat surprisingly the first Azúcar Moreno lead single since the late 1980s to be issued without any accompanying dance remixes, and the follow-up's "Sobreviviré", "Se Me Va" and "El" were never commercially released, but only as promo singles distributed to radio stations and disc jockeys - again without any remixes; in Spain the album sold some 50.000 copies, making it their first studio album since 1988's _Carne De Melocotón_ not to go platinum or multi-platinum in their home country. _Desde El Principio_ also came to be the duo's final album for the Sony Music Entertainment label, a company they after a series of mergers in various forms had been signed to for some fifteen years (CBS Records Spain, Epic Records Spain, CBS-Epic Spain, eventually a sublabel to Sony Music Spain, today a subsidiary to the multinational Sony BMG Music Entertainment conglomerate). In 2006 Azúcar Moreno returned to their previous label EMI Music for the album _Bailando Con Lola_.
While Sony Music have continued to release hits compilations with Azúcar Moreno all through the 2000s, such as _Toda La Pasión De Azúcar Moreno_ (2001), _Colección De Oro_ (2002), _20 Grandes Exitos_ (2003), _Los Esenciales_ (2003) and _20 Exitos Originales_ (2005), as well as numerous mid-price collections, none of these include any new recordings, remixes or tracks not to be found on the duo's ten studio albums for the CBS/Epic/Sony label, several of the duo's greatest hits do however appear in edited form.

_**Desde El Principio**_ is the twelfth studio album by Spanish duo Azúcar Moreno, released on Sony International in 2004.

The album saw the Salazar sisters joining forces with a new production team; drummer and percussionist Sergio Castillo and keyboardist Francisco Amat. Castillo and Amat began their career in music in the early 1980s and had previously produced albums with among others Cuban singer Silvio Rodríguez, Tunisian-FrenchDany Brillant, and in the late 90s and early 2000s most notably the young Spanish rumba-rock duo Estopa to great success.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desde_El_Principio#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Desde_El_Principio#cite_note-2) Productionwise _Desde El Principio_ marked a return to Azúcar Moreno's winning formula of the early 90s in that it mixed mainstream Latin pop with material from a wide variety of genres. Tracks like "Sangre Española", "Me Quedo Contigo" and "Vamos a Dejarlo Así" mainly featured drums, percussion and Spanish guitars, recorded live, while lead single "Mi Ritmo" was a typical Azúcar Moreno dance track with a more synthesized and contemporary urban sound. Just like 1991's _Mambo_ the album also featured flamenco/dance covers of a number of pop classics like "[Don't Let Me Be Misunderstood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Don't_Let_Me_Be_Misunderstood "Don't Let Me Be Misunderstood")", a hit for both Nina Simone and The Animals in the 60s and also turned into disco classic by Santa Esmeralda in 1977, the Neapolitan traditional "[¡Oh Sole Mío!](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/'O_Sole_Mio "'O Sole Mio")", also covered by Elvis Presley in English as "[It's Now Or Never](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/It's_Now_or_Never_(song) "It's Now or Never (song)")", but, Azúcar Moreno's large LGBT following in both Europe and South America considered, most importantly their take on Gloria Gaynor's 1979 gay anthem "I Will Survive", retitled "Sobreviviré".

Despite this _Desde El Principio_ proved to be a modest commercial success. "Mi Ritmo" was somewhat surprisingly the first Azúcar Moreno lead single since the late 1980s to be issued without any accompanying dance remixes, and the follow-up's "Sobreviviré", "Se Me Va" and "El" were never commercially released, but only as promo singles distributed to radio stations and disc jockeys - again without any remixes; in Spain the album sold some 50.000 copies, making it their first studio album since 1988's _Carne De Melocotón_ not to go platinum or multi-platinum in their home country. _Desde El Principio_ also came to be the duo's final album for the Sony Music Entertainment label, a company they after a series of mergers in various forms had been signed to for some fifteen years (CBS Records Spain, Epic Records Spain, CBS-Epic Spain, eventually a sublabel to Sony Music Spain, today a subsidiary to the multinational Sony BMG Music Entertainment conglomerate). In 2006 Azúcar Moreno returned to their previous label EMI Music for the album _Bailando Con Lola_.
While Sony Music have continued to release hits compilations with Azúcar Moreno all through the 2000s, such as _Toda La Pasión De Azúcar Moreno_ (2001), _Colección De Oro_ (2002), _20 Grandes Exitos_ (2003), _Los Esenciales_ (2003) and _20 Exitos Originales_ (2005), as well as numerous mid-price collections, none of these include any new recordings, remixes or tracks not to be found on the duo's ten studio albums for the CBS/Epic/Sony label, several of the duo's greatest hits do however appear in edited form.

# NYCFC Elige a Hok Y Turner Construction Company Para Diseñar Y Construir El Primer Estadio Específicamente Para El Fútbol en Nueva York
**Rashed Singaby director y diseñador principal del proyecto de HOK,** expresó su entusiasmo por la colaboración, citando un compromiso compartido con el diseño centrado en la comunidad. “Es un honor trabajar con NYCFC para diseñar el primer estadio específicamente para el fútbol de la ciudad de Nueva York para los campeonatos de la MLS del 2021. El estadio ejemplificará el dinamismo y la diversidad cultural de la ciudad de Nueva York y será un ejemplo vibrante de creación de espacios urbanos. Nuestro diseño incorporará la identidad multifacética de Queens, Flushing Meadows, y la historia industrial del área, ofreciendo una experiencia de día de juego única e integrándose en la comunidad como un bien diario.”
El diseño de HOK estratégicamente posicionará al estadio a lo largo del borde de la calle 126, integrando con la red de la ciudad para optimizar el uso de tierra e incorporar el espacio abierto público. Además de ser el hogar de NYCFC, el estadio proporcionará una variedad de servicios y eventos durante todo el año. Diseñado para ser asequible para los peatones, el estadio exhibirá tecnología de vanguardia, ofrecerá flexibilidad y creará una gran experiencia de llegada. El estadio está al lado del USTA Billie Jean King Tennis Center y del Citi Field de los New York Mets, creando una destinación de clase mundial para los deportes y el entretenimiento en Queens.
Turner Construction Company tiene un grupo dedicado al deporte que une una enorme variedad de recursos especializados en los aspectos ùnicos de la construcción deportiva. El grupo deportivo de Turner está formado por un personal dedicado y apasionado con la experiencia, el conocimiento de la industria, la creatividad, y el ingenio para cumplir con sus compromisos. Los clientes de Turner incluyen equipos profesionales de fútbol, fútbol americano, béisbol, hockey, y baloncesto.
Turner ha trabajado en muchos de los mejores recintos deportivos del mundo, incluyendo TQL Stadium, SoFi Stadium, Lower.com Field, Golden 1 Center, Yankee Stadium, Madison Square Garden, Levi’s Stadium, y Intuit Dome. Turner tiene una reputación de gestión de proyectos seguros y eficientes y de soluciones inovadoras a desafíos complejos.

# NYCFC Elige a Hok Y Turner Construction Company Para Diseñar Y Construir El Primer Estadio Específicamente Para El Fútbol en Nueva York
“Es un honor ser parte del equipo construyendo el nuevo hogar de NYCFC. El estadio elevará la experiencia para este increíble equipo y sus apoyadores,” **dijo vicepresidente de Turner y director general Charlie Whitney.** “Desde el principio de nuestra participación, entendimos la importancia de este proyecto y el impacto positivo y la transformación que traerá a toda la comunidad. Esperamos seguir trabajando en cerca colaboración con HOK y el resto del equipo en los años que vienen para alcanzar nuestros objetivos comunes, cumplir nuestros compromisos y hacer de este proyecto una realidad para NYCFC y la ciudad de Nueva York.”
HOK y Turner Construction Company han tenido una relación por 50 años, y en ese tiempo las firmas han completado más de 400 proyectos juntos. Han logrado proyectos en Nueva York y en todos los Estados Unidos a gran escala con éxito, desde proyectos corporativos hasta proyectos que proporcionan servicios médicos, científicos, tecnológicos, deportivos, y de entretenimiento.
Por casi una década, NYCFC ha invertido en las comunidades locales a través de la ciudad de Nueva York a través de su fundación. La fundación se alojará dentro del nuevo estadio, permitiendo la expansión de sus programas de fútbol gratis disponibles para la comunidad local de Queens.
Queens Development Group, una empresa conjunta entre Related Companies y Sterling Equities, supervisará el desarrollo del estadio y el distrito. El proyecto entrará en el proceso de aprobación del Uniform Land Use Review Procedure a finales de este año y será revisado por el New York City Public Design Commission. NYCFC trabajará para finalizar el diseño del estadio para alinearse con la entrada en el proceso de aprobación de ULURP a finales de este año. Se proyecta que el estadio y su desarrollo generarán más de 14,200 puestos de trabajo locales durante la construcción, con 1,550 posiciones permanentes creadas al terminar.
Haga clic aquí para registrarse y recibir actualizaciones sobre el proyecto del estadio.

# Centro de Desarrollo Profesional
## Lo que dice nuestra comunidad
### Mercedez Davidson
Participante del Programa de Finalización Universitaria
Cuando tomé el curso CDA en 2018, solo necesitaba 16-18 créditos de educación para el trabajo, pero no me di cuenta de que aprendería tanto de ese programa y cómo me cambiaría y se convertiría en el catalizador que necesitaba para volver a la escuela y terminar mi título. Cambió mi perspectiva y realmente me hizo una mejor educadora. Luego, la vida siguió su curso y me olvidé de intentar seguir con la escuela y mi carrera profesional actual a tiempo completo, parecía demasiado trabajo. Pero entonces el mundo se detuvo y tuve tiempo libre por primera vez en años, y cuando me comuniqué contigo en 2020 para que me ayudaras a solicitar un programa de tiempo completo para pregrado, me ayudaste y me conectaste con Antonee. Estaré eternamente agradecida. Ahora, estoy a 3 clases de la meta final, estoy muy emocionada de cerrar este capítulo y orgullosa de mí misma por finalmente llevarlo a cabo. Le debo mucho al conocimiento que aprendí de ti y de los otros profesores en el programa CDA. Así que, con ese pensamiento en mente, he decidido solicitar la escuela de posgrado, CUNY SPS por supuesto, en el programa de Estudios de la Juventud.
Leer más

# Centro de Desarrollo Profesional
## Lo que dice nuestra comunidad
### Khadijah Frederick
Graduada del Certificado CDA, 2018
Estoy realmente agradecida de haber sido premiada con la beca CUNY/SUNY Workforce y las becas QSNY. Recibir estas becas me ha ayudado a obtener mi credencial CPAC, lo que marcará mi trayectoria profesional. Gracias a su apoyo, ahora tengo la capacidad de estudiar sin la carga financiera de pagar este curso. Gracias por invertir en mi futuro ayudándome a dar un paso más cerca de convertirme en una Administradora de Programas de Cuidado Infantil eficaz.
Leer más

# Centro de Desarrollo Profesional
## Lo que dice nuestra comunidad
### Elizabeth DiCarlo
Participante de la Beca para la Fuerza Laboral
Gracias a la beca CUNY/SUNY Workforce, pude asistir a Hudson Valley Community College y recibir mi certificado en Administración de Primera Infancia. Pude hacer mis clases en la comodidad de mi hogar, en línea, después de trabajar 12 horas al día. Con este certificado, puedo obtener mi Credencial de Administrador de Programas Infantiles. Esto era lo último que necesitaba para tener las calificaciones para convertirme en la directora del centro de cuidado infantil que planeo abrir este año. ¡También puedo mostrar a mis hijos y amigos que nunca es demasiado tarde para ir a la universidad! Si tienes un sueño... ¡alcánzalo!

# NYCFC Elige a Hok Y Turner Construction Company Para Diseñar Y Construir El Primer Estadio Específicamente Para El Fútbol en Nueva York
**Rashed Singaby director y diseñador principal del proyecto de HOK,** expresó su entusiasmo por la colaboración, citando un compromiso compartido con el diseño centrado en la comunidad. “Es un honor trabajar con NYCFC para diseñar el primer estadio específicamente para el fútbol de la ciudad de Nueva York para los campeonatos de la MLS del 2021. El estadio ejemplificará el dinamismo y la diversidad cultural de la ciudad de Nueva York y será un ejemplo vibrante de creación de espacios urbanos. Nuestro diseño incorporará la identidad multifacética de Queens, Flushing Meadows, y la historia industrial del área, ofreciendo una experiencia de día de juego única e integrándose en la comunidad como un bien diario.”
El diseño de HOK estratégicamente posicionará al estadio a lo largo del borde de la calle 126, integrando con la red de la ciudad para optimizar el uso de tierra e incorporar el espacio abierto público. Además de ser el hogar de NYCFC, el estadio proporcionará una variedad de servicios y eventos durante todo el año. Diseñado para ser asequible para los peatones, el estadio exhibirá tecnología de vanguardia, ofrecerá flexibilidad y creará una gran experiencia de llegada. El estadio está al lado del USTA Billie Jean King Tennis Center y del Citi Field de los New York Mets, creando una destinación de clase mundial para los deportes y el entretenimiento en Queens.
Turner Construction Company tiene un grupo dedicado al deporte que une una enorme variedad de recursos especializados en los aspectos ùnicos de la construcción deportiva. El grupo deportivo de Turner está formado por un personal dedicado y apasionado con la experiencia, el conocimiento de la industria, la creatividad, y el ingenio para cumplir con sus compromisos. Los clientes de Turner incluyen equipos profesionales de fútbol, fútbol americano, béisbol, hockey, y baloncesto.
Turner ha trabajado en muchos de los mejores recintos deportivos del mundo, incluyendo TQL Stadium, SoFi Stadium, Lower.com Field, Golden 1 Center, Yankee Stadium, Madison Square Garden, Levi’s Stadium, y Intuit Dome. Turner tiene una reputación de gestión de proyectos seguros y eficientes y de soluciones inovadoras a desafíos complejos.

# NYCFC Elige a Hok Y Turner Construction Company Para Diseñar Y Construir El Primer Estadio Específicamente Para El Fútbol en Nueva York
“Es un honor ser parte del equipo construyendo el nuevo hogar de NYCFC. El estadio elevará la experiencia para este increíble equipo y sus apoyadores,” **dijo vicepresidente de Turner y director general Charlie Whitney.** “Desde el principio de nuestra participación, entendimos la importancia de este proyecto y el impacto positivo y la transformación que traerá a toda la comunidad. Esperamos seguir trabajando en cerca colaboración con HOK y el resto del equipo en los años que vienen para alcanzar nuestros objetivos comunes, cumplir nuestros compromisos y hacer de este proyecto una realidad para NYCFC y la ciudad de Nueva York.”
HOK y Turner Construction Company han tenido una relación por 50 años, y en ese tiempo las firmas han completado más de 400 proyectos juntos. Han logrado proyectos en Nueva York y en todos los Estados Unidos a gran escala con éxito, desde proyectos corporativos hasta proyectos que proporcionan servicios médicos, científicos, tecnológicos, deportivos, y de entretenimiento.
Por casi una década, NYCFC ha invertido en las comunidades locales a través de la ciudad de Nueva York a través de su fundación. La fundación se alojará dentro del nuevo estadio, permitiendo la expansión de sus programas de fútbol gratis disponibles para la comunidad local de Queens.
Queens Development Group, una empresa conjunta entre Related Companies y Sterling Equities, supervisará el desarrollo del estadio y el distrito. El proyecto entrará en el proceso de aprobación del Uniform Land Use Review Procedure a finales de este año y será revisado por el New York City Public Design Commission. NYCFC trabajará para finalizar el diseño del estadio para alinearse con la entrada en el proceso de aprobación de ULURP a finales de este año. Se proyecta que el estadio y su desarrollo generarán más de 14,200 puestos de trabajo locales durante la construcción, con 1,550 posiciones permanentes creadas al terminar.

# NYCFC Elige a Hok Y Turner Construction Company Para Diseñar Y Construir El Primer Estadio Específicamente Para El Fútbol en Nueva York
**Rashed Singaby director y diseñador principal del proyecto de HOK,** expresó su entusiasmo por la colaboración, citando un compromiso compartido con el diseño centrado en la comunidad. “Es un honor trabajar con NYCFC para diseñar el primer estadio específicamente para el fútbol de la ciudad de Nueva York para los campeonatos de la MLS del 2021. El estadio ejemplificará el dinamismo y la diversidad cultural de la ciudad de Nueva York y será un ejemplo vibrante de creación de espacios urbanos. Nuestro diseño incorporará la identidad multifacética de Queens, Flushing Meadows, y la historia industrial del área, ofreciendo una experiencia de día de juego única e integrándose en la comunidad como un bien diario.”
El diseño de HOK estratégicamente posicionará al estadio a lo largo del borde de la calle 126, integrando con la red de la ciudad para optimizar el uso de tierra e incorporar el espacio abierto público. Además de ser el hogar de NYCFC, el estadio proporcionará una variedad de servicios y eventos durante todo el año. Diseñado para ser asequible para los peatones, el estadio exhibirá tecnología de vanguardia, ofrecerá flexibilidad y creará una gran experiencia de llegada. El estadio está al lado del USTA Billie Jean King Tennis Center y del Citi Field de los New York Mets, creando una destinación de clase mundial para los deportes y el entretenimiento en Queens.
Turner Construction Company tiene un grupo dedicado al deporte que une una enorme variedad de recursos especializados en los aspectos ùnicos de la construcción deportiva. El grupo deportivo de Turner está formado por un personal dedicado y apasionado con la experiencia, el conocimiento de la industria, la creatividad, y el ingenio para cumplir con sus compromisos. Los clientes de Turner incluyen equipos profesionales de fútbol, fútbol americano, béisbol, hockey, y baloncesto.
Turner ha trabajado en muchos de los mejores recintos deportivos del mundo, incluyendo TQL Stadium, SoFi Stadium, Lower.com Field, Golden 1 Center, Yankee Stadium, Madison Square Garden, Levi’s Stadium, y Intuit Dome. Turner tiene una reputación de gestión de proyectos seguros y eficientes y de soluciones inovadoras a desafíos complejos.

# NYCFC Elige a Hok Y Turner Construction Company Para Diseñar Y Construir El Primer Estadio Específicamente Para El Fútbol en Nueva York
“Es un honor ser parte del equipo construyendo el nuevo hogar de NYCFC. El estadio elevará la experiencia para este increíble equipo y sus apoyadores,” **dijo vicepresidente de Turner y director general Charlie Whitney.** “Desde el principio de nuestra participación, entendimos la importancia de este proyecto y el impacto positivo y la transformación que traerá a toda la comunidad. Esperamos seguir trabajando en cerca colaboración con HOK y el resto del equipo en los años que vienen para alcanzar nuestros objetivos comunes, cumplir nuestros compromisos y hacer de este proyecto una realidad para NYCFC y la ciudad de Nueva York.”
HOK y Turner Construction Company han tenido una relación por 50 años, y en ese tiempo las firmas han completado más de 400 proyectos juntos. Han logrado proyectos en Nueva York y en todos los Estados Unidos a gran escala con éxito, desde proyectos corporativos hasta proyectos que proporcionan servicios médicos, científicos, tecnológicos, deportivos, y de entretenimiento.
Por casi una década, NYCFC ha invertido en las comunidades locales a través de la ciudad de Nueva York a través de su fundación. La fundación se alojará dentro del nuevo estadio, permitiendo la expansión de sus programas de fútbol gratis disponibles para la comunidad local de Queens.
Queens Development Group, una empresa conjunta entre Related Companies y Sterling Equities, supervisará el desarrollo del estadio y el distrito. El proyecto entrará en el proceso de aprobación del Uniform Land Use Review Procedure a finales de este año y será revisado por el New York City Public Design Commission. NYCFC trabajará para finalizar el diseño del estadio para alinearse con la entrada en el proceso de aprobación de ULURP a finales de este año. Se proyecta que el estadio y su desarrollo generarán más de 14,200 puestos de trabajo locales durante la construcción, con 1,550 posiciones permanentes creadas al terminar.

# Odisei Music
## Updates
🎙️🎷La semana pasada estuve en un podcast contando la historia de Odisei Music desde el principio. Y ha sido una de las reflexiones más honestas que he hecho en mucho tiempo. Desde aquel primer Kickstarter con un prototipo de papel de aluminio que se cogía con pinzas, hasta los primeros saxofones montados en casa durante el confinamiento, el lanzamiento del Travel Clarinet, cómo estamos usando inteligencia artificial hoy en el equipo, y todo lo que hemos aprendido por el camino. No es una entrevista de éxitos. Es un repaso real de lo que significa construir algo desde cero: los errores, las decisiones difíciles, los momentos en que no sabes si va a salir bien. Gracias a todas las personas que se han cruzado en este proyecto tan bonito. Los que ya no están, el equipo actual y los que quedan por llegar! # Odisei Music
## Updates
Ramon fundó Odisei Music en 2019. Sin inversores. Sin rondas. Con 25.000€ de ahorros y una idea. La idea: hacer el saxofón más pequeño del mundo. Hizo la precampaña de Kickstarter escribiendo DMs a mano a saxofonistas en Instagram. Cero euros de marketing. 110.000€ recaudados en 30 días. Pero tenían un problema: habían prometido entregar en 6 meses y el prototipo era de papel de aluminio. Así que se fueron a Shenzhen a buscar proveedores. Volvieron. Empezaron a fabricar. Y llegó el Covid. Montaban los saxofones cada uno en su casa, como si fuera una pizza. Y se intercambiaban las piezas clandestinamente en el parking del Caprabo, planta -2, con los coches en fila y los maleteros abiertos. Ese año facturaron 100.000€. Hoy facturan más de 2.000.000€ y venden en más de 50 países. Lo que me quedé de la conversación: Ramón dice que con todo lo que sabe hoy, en 2019 no habría emprendido. Pero lo volvería a hacer. Eso es lo que diferencia a los que construyen algo real de los que solo lo piensan. Dejo el episodio completo en los comentarios 👇

# Odisei Music
## Updates
Last Thursday, we had the honour to attend the Fundación SIFU SuperArte charity gala, and for us, this was much more than just an event. 💙 A while back, they trusted us with a special order of our Adaptive Travel Sax units for their musicians, marking the beginning of a beautiful journey focused on accessible music. Our instrument was designed specifically for older adults and people with accessibility needs. It features tailored ergonomics and an adapted blowing mechanism. Seeing how music becomes a powerful tool for inclusion and self-expression reminds us why we do what we do. It was also a pleasure to attend the charity dinner co-organized by Grupo Hotusa and to connect with other inspiring projects in this space, such as EyeHarp and 𝗕𝗹𝘂𝗲𝗠𝗶𝗿𝗿𝗼𝗿 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵, amongst others. Seeing how music becomes a powerful tool for inclusion and self-expression reminds us why we do what we do. Thank you to Fundación Grupo SIFU and Grupo Hotusa for such an inspiring night. 🌍✨

Last Thursday, we had the honour to attend the Fundación SIFU SuperArte charity gala, and for us, this was much more than just an event. 💙 A while back, they trusted us with a special order of our Adaptive Travel Sax units for their musicians, marking the beginning of a beautiful journey focused on accessible music. Our instrument was designed specifically for older adults and people with accessibility needs. It features tailored ergonomics and an adapted blowing mechanism. Seeing how music becomes a powerful tool for inclusion and self-expression reminds us why we do what we do. It was also a pleasure to attend the charity dinner co-organized by Grupo Hotusa and to connect with other inspiring projects in this space, such as EyeHarp and 𝗕𝗹𝘂𝗲𝗠𝗶𝗿𝗿𝗼𝗿 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵, amongst others. Seeing how music becomes a powerful tool for inclusion and self-expression reminds us why we do what we do. Thank you to Fundación Grupo SIFU and Grupo Hotusa for such an inspiring night. 🌍✨

# Odisei Music
## Updates
Ramon fundó Odisei Music en 2019. Sin inversores. Sin rondas. Con 25.000€ de ahorros y una idea. La idea: hacer el saxofón más pequeño del mundo. Hizo la precampaña de Kickstarter escribiendo DMs a mano a saxofonistas en Instagram. Cero euros de marketing. 110.000€ recaudados en 30 días. Pero tenían un problema: habían prometido entregar en 6 meses y el prototipo era de papel de aluminio. Así que se fueron a Shenzhen a buscar proveedores. Volvieron. Empezaron a fabricar. Y llegó el Covid. Montaban los saxofones cada uno en su casa, como si fuera una pizza. Y se intercambiaban las piezas clandestinamente en el parking del Caprabo, planta -2, con los coches en fila y los maleteros abiertos. Ese año facturaron 100.000€. Hoy facturan más de 2.000.000€ y venden en más de 50 países. Lo que me quedé de la conversación: Ramón dice que con todo lo que sabe hoy, en 2019 no habría emprendido. Pero lo volvería a hacer. Eso es lo que diferencia a los que construyen algo real de los que solo lo piensan. Dejo el episodio completo en los comentarios 👇

I may need to accept that without access to more detailed information about specific record label organizations and their headquarters, I cannot definitively trace the exact connection the question is asking about.

# Madison Renewed as Platinum Bicycle Friendly Community
posted February 7, 2024 - 10:08am
I am proud to share that the City of Madison had its status renewed as aLeague of American Bicyclists recognized Platinum Bicycle Friendly Community (BFC)!
As part of our commitment to be a great place to live and thrive, we applied for renewal of the League of American Bicyclists’ prestigious Bicycle Friendly Community award. It has long been our goal to have a best-in-class transportation system that serves everyone who lives and visits our community, and that includes building a community more accessible by bike. Today, we’re proud to be part of the 480 communities across the United States that are transforming America, one Bicycle Friendly Community at a time.
People across our community are biking more than ever, for commuting, for trips to the store or other errands, for exercise, and often just for fun.
The Platinum BFC award recognizes Madison’s commitment to improving conditions for all people who bike through investments in bike education programs, bike events that promote and encourage people to choose biking, pro-bike policies, and bike infrastructure. We have expanded bike facilities across the City in the last year, including multi-use paths on Hammersley Rd, Atwood Ave, and Dempsey/Davies, as well as cycle tracks on Wilson and Broom.
There are even more improvements currently in construction and planned for future years. We are pleased to celebrate this award and our achievements for building a better community together.
See the full announcement.

##
**Ready to ride?**With nearly **60 miles**of bike-friendly paths and roadways, riding a bicycle or e-scooter is one of the best ways to get around Norfolk! As part of the City of Norfolk’s **Multimodal Transportation Master Plan** and **Vision Zero** policy, we're committed to making riding a bike or e-scooter safer and more convenient by:
*   **Designing and implementing new bikeways** to expand and improve our active transportation network  
*   **Providing e-bikes and e-scooters**through the Micromobility program  
*   **Increasing dedicated bicycle and e-scooter parking**throughout the City  
*   **Promoting active transportation** through Norfolk Bike Month, Pedestrian Safety Awareness Month and other initiatives
In 2023, The City of Norfolk received a bronze-level**Bicycle Friendly Community Award** by the League of American Bicyclist!
Check out the full 2023 Report Cardor learn more about the League’s BFC Program.

## Norfolk's Bike Network & Facilities Map
This interactive map features the location data of the following bike &e-scooter facilities:
*   Shared-use paths  
*   Bike lanes  
*   Shared lanes  
*   Elizabeth River Trail  
*   Northside Park Mountain Bike Trails  
*   Bike racks  
*   E-scooter corrals  
*   Bike repair stations
Click below to find out more about Norfolk's bike-friendly trails:

## Rules of the Road
**What should I know when bicycling or riding an e-scooter in Norfolk?**
*   Riders traveling on roadways have all the general rights and duties of vehicle drivers.  
*   Helmet use is mandatory for riders under the age of 14 and is strongly recommended for all others.  
*   Sidewalk riding is allowed except in Downtown Norfolk (ordinance).  
*   Riders must yield to pedestrians on sidewalks and at crosswalks.  
*   A white headlight and a red reflector or taillight are required by law when riding at night.
**As a driver, what should I know about bicycling in Norfolk?**
*   Bicyclists and scooter riders are allowed on all streets and on most sidewalks.  
*   When turning left or right, check for pedestrians and bicyclists.  
*   When turning right across a bike lane, check for cyclists, merge into the bike lane, and then execute your turn.  
*   Bikes lanes are reserved for bicyclists. Do not park or drive in bike lanes.
**For a full list of local bike laws and safety tips, visit****VDOT Bike Safe**

## **Bike Safety Resources**

*   League of American Bicyclists: Smart Cycling  
*   VDOT Bike Safety  
*   NHTSA Bicycle Safety  
*   FHWA Pedestrian & Bicycle Safety

# Madison Renewed as Platinum Bicycle Friendly Community
posted February 7, 2024 - 10:08am
I am proud to share that the City of Madison had its status renewed as aLeague of American Bicyclists recognized Platinum Bicycle Friendly Community (BFC)!
As part of our commitment to be a great place to live and thrive, we applied for renewal of the League of American Bicyclists’ prestigious Bicycle Friendly Community award. It has long been our goal to have a best-in-class transportation system that serves everyone who lives and visits our community, and that includes building a community more accessible by bike. Today, we’re proud to be part of the 480 communities across the United States that are transforming America, one Bicycle Friendly Community at a time.
People across our community are biking more than ever, for commuting, for trips to the store or other errands, for exercise, and often just for fun.
The Platinum BFC award recognizes Madison’s commitment to improving conditions for all people who bike through investments in bike education programs, bike events that promote and encourage people to choose biking, pro-bike policies, and bike infrastructure. We have expanded bike facilities across the City in the last year, including multi-use paths on Hammersley Rd, Atwood Ave, and Dempsey/Davies, as well as cycle tracks on Wilson and Broom.
There are even more improvements currently in construction and planned for future years. We are pleased to celebrate this award and our achievements for building a better community together.
See the full announcement.

**What should I know when bicycling or riding an e-scooter in Norfolk?**
*   Riders traveling on roadways have all the general rights and duties of vehicle drivers.  
*   Helmet use is mandatory for riders under the age of 14 and is strongly recommended for all others.

*   Bicyclists and scooter riders are allowed on all streets and on most sidewalks.

# Madison Renewed as Platinum Bicycle Friendly Community
posted February 7, 2024 - 10:08am
I am proud to share that the City of Madison had its status renewed as aLeague of American Bicyclists recognized Platinum Bicycle Friendly Community (BFC)!
As part of our commitment to be a great place to live and thrive, we applied for renewal of the League of American Bicyclists’ prestigious Bicycle Friendly Community award. It has long been our goal to have a best-in-class transportation system that serves everyone who lives and visits our community, and that includes building a community more accessible by bike. Today, we’re proud to be part of the 480 communities across the United States that are transforming America, one Bicycle Friendly Community at a time.
People across our community are biking more than ever, for commuting, for trips to the store or other errands, for exercise, and often just for fun.
The Platinum BFC award recognizes Madison’s commitment to improving conditions for all people who bike through investments in bike education programs, bike events that promote and encourage people to choose biking, pro-bike policies, and bike infrastructure. We have expanded bike facilities across the City in the last year, including multi-use paths on Hammersley Rd, Atwood Ave, and Dempsey/Davies, as well as cycle tracks on Wilson and Broom.
There are even more improvements currently in construction and planned for future years. We are pleased to celebrate this award and our achievements for building a better community together.

Title: 91 Places Earned Bicycle Friendly Community Awards in 2024
Chunks: 0,1,2,3
At a time when many are looking for ways to strengthen their communities, local investments in better bicycling offer a path forward. Today, the League of American Bicyclists is proud to recognize 91 new and renewing Bicycle Friendly Communities (BFCs), along with eight honorable mentions, celebrating local efforts to make biking safer and more accessible for millions of Americans. From major metropolitan areas like Phoenix, AZ (population 1.6M), to small rural towns like Frazee, MN (population 1,316), this round demonstrates how prioritizing bicycling can create healthier, more vibrant communities in any size or setting.
“Bicycling is more than just a mode of transportation—it’s a powerful tool for building healthier communities, fostering sustainability, and connecting people,” said Bill Nesper, executive director of the League of American Bicyclists. “The cities, regions, and towns recognized in this round of Bicycle Friendly Community awards are leading the way by investing in infrastructure and programs that make biking an easier, safer, and more accessible choice. Their leadership demonstrates that supporting bicycling is an investment in a healthier future for everyone.”
When municipalities apply for an award from the Bicycle Friendly Community program, they fill out an extensive application which requires collaboration across city agencies and with local advocates and other partners. Based on the communities’ responses, the League determines if they deserve recognition and at which award level. Critically, a report card with feedback from the League’s expert reviewers offers next steps that each applicant community can take to improve how well they support people who bike in the future.
Leadership at both the state and local levels is pivotal in shaping if and how communities prioritize better bicycling. This round highlights the impact of that leadership, particularly in Washington state, the League’s #1 Bicycle Friendly State, which boasts seven new and renewing Bicycle Friendly Communities. Washington’s commitment to spreading the joy of bicycling has stood the test of time — for example, newly upgraded Silver-level BFC Anacortes has operated a free bikeshare program at its ferry port since 1997 and continues to promote cycling safety and fitness for all ages and abilities. Access to comprehensive bike education is a key contributing factor to Washington’s success as the top-ranking Bicycle Friendly State, and our feedback for several Bicycle Friendly Communities encourages them to take advantage of Cascade Bicycle Club’s incredible statewide cycling education program, if they aren’t already.

Washington’s leadership is inspiring progress (or perhaps healthy competition) in neighboring states as well. In Oregon, Eugene submitted an exceptionally strong renewal application, reaffirming its status as a Gold-level Bicycle Friendly Community. In Idaho, the capital city of Boise has set an example with a standout application highlighting the city’s ongoing efforts to improve bicycling for all. This year, Boise and surrounding Ada County both applied for higher award levels and both successfully earned Gold-level Bicycle Friendly Community status, demonstrating their shared commitment to creating safer, more accessible streets. Their efforts are strengthened by local partnerships with local groups such as Boise State University, a Platinum-level Bicycle Friendly University; the Boise Bicycle Project, a Platinum-level Bicycle Friendly Business; as well as public health agencies and many other partners, aligning transportation planning with broader community well-being goals.
**Case Study: Looking Ahead to Platinum**
Boise’s approach prioritizes safety, accessibility, and inclusive mobility. Both Boise and Ada County have adopted Vision Zero commitments and the Ada County Highway District (ACHD)’s Livable Streets Performance Measures ensure bike infrastructure is designed for people of all ages and abilities. The city’s Adaptive Recreation Program and Safe Routes to School initiatives expand cycling access, while Boise’s efforts to reduce speed limits have resulted in 76.81% of the city’s roads (over 1,100 miles) being set to 20 MPH or less.
Community input via our public survey plays a crucial role in the BFC evaluation process, helping to shape recommendations for future improvements. In addition to their feedback report card, all applicants receive a full report of their public survey results and this local input also informs the recommendations provided to each community on the League’s BFC report card. One highlight from Boise’s BFC public survey is a rising demand for improved maintenance practices on bike facilities, emphasizing the need not just to build infrastructure but to keep it safe and accessible year-round. With a growing network of low-speed streets, protected bike lanes, and a vibrant car-free downtown corridor, Boise’s new Gold-level status sets a strong example for active transportation in the Mountain West — and with improved maintenance practices, a Platinum BFC award could be on the horizon.

Along with Boise, this round features six other state capitals celebrating BFC status including renewing Bronze-level Nashville, Tennessee; newly Bronze-level Cheyenne, Wyoming; and Honolulu, Hawaii, which moved up to Silver-level status in this round after holding Bronze since 2014. Many of these communities show a commitment to improving active transportation as a way to make their residents happier, healthier, and better connected. In renewing Bronze-level Topeka, Kansas, “Ridership has visibly increased as a result of increased infrastructure and community investment in the active transportation culture.” Local leaders have forged local partnerships to pursue multi-modal transportation grants on behalf of the city and county, resulting in 28 new miles of on-street bike lanes and side paths being added to Topeka’s bikeways network since 2020.
Of the 91 communities being recognized in this announcement, 16 communities are moving up in award levels, 67 are renewing at the same level, and eight first-time applicants have earned Bronze on their first application. After all award status expirations and additions, there are now 460 recognized Bicycle Friendly Communities nationwide, with 76 million people living in a current BFC. From bustling cities to quiet countryside towns, these communities are leading the way in showing that investments in bicycling not only improve infrastructure but also the quality of life for everyone. As places across the nation step up to prioritize active transportation, the momentum for safer, more accessible biking at the local level continues to grow stronger.
To explore all the communities recognized in this round, see the full list of current and past Bicycle Friendly Communities here. Any community that would like to join, return to, or stay on the BFC list, can start their new or renewal application and submit by June 25, 2025 to be reviewed in the next round.
Apply to BFC program
**About the Bicycle Friendly Community℠ Program**
Bicycle Friendly Community awards reflect local leaders’ ongoing work to build better places to bike and evaluate those efforts as part of a national movement. Each of the five levels of the Bicycle Friendly University award – diamond, platinum, gold, silver, and bronze, plus an honorable mention category – provide a clear path for cities and towns to continuously improve. Visit bikeleague.org/community to learn more about the BFC program.
**About the League Of American Bicyclists**

Since 1880, the League of American Bicyclists has been people-powered, with a goal to make bicycling safer and easier as a means of transportation and recreation. Today, the League continues to improve lives and strengthen communities through bicycling. We are more than 200,000 members and supporters strong with more than 1,000 state and local advocacy groups and bike clubs as well as thousands of businesses, universities, and communities together leading the movement to create a Bicycle Friendly America for everyone.

# Accolades
## 2025
### Certificate of Achievement for Excellence in Financial Reporting
The Government Finance Officer Association (GFOA) established the Certificate of Achievement for Excellence in Financial Reporting Program (COA) in 1945 to encourage and assist state and local governments to go beyond the minimum requirements of generally accepted accounting principles to prepare annual comprehensive financial reports that evidence the spirit of transparency and full disclosure and then to recognize individual governments that succeed in achieving that goal. The goal of the program is not to assess the financial health of participating governments, but rather to ensure that users of their financial statements have the information they need to do so themselves.
* * *

# Accolades
## 2025
### Distinguished Budget Presentation Award
The Government Finance Officer Association (GFOA) established the Distinguished Budget Presentation Awards Program (Budget Awards Program) in 1984 to encourage and assist state and local governments to prepare budget documents of the very highest quality that reflect both the guidelines established by the National Advisory Council on State and Local Budgeting and the GFOA's best practices on budgeting and then to recognize individual governments that succeed in achieving that goal. Approximately 1,800 governments, including states, cities, counties, special districts, school districts, and more have been recognized for transparency in budgeting. To earn recognition, budget documents must meet program criteria and excel as a policy document, financial plan, operations guide, and communication tool.
* * *

# Accolades
## 2025
### Communicator Awards
The Communications Department earned two Communicator Awards of Distinction from the Academy of Interactive and Visual Arts (AIVA) in the categories of Print Content-Environmental and Sustainability for the signage design at The Lookout at the George Mitchell Nature Preserve; and in the category of Individual Display Advertising B-to-C for the Rodeo Express online advertisement.
* * *

# Accolades
## 2025
### TAMI Award of Excellence
The Woodlands Township Communications Department won an Award of Excellence at the Texas Association of Municipal Information Officers (TAMIO) conference for The Woodlands Community Magazine.
* * *

# Accolades
## 2025
### Keep Texas Beautiful
For the fourth year in a row, Keep Texas Beautiful (KTB), a statewide grassroots environmental and community improvement non-profit organization, designated The Woodlands Township as a Gold Star Affiliate in recognition of its efforts to maintain and improve the environment. Gold Star recognition is the highest status membership recognition any community affiliate can achieve.
* * *

# Accolades
## 2025
### TATOA Video Award
The Woodlands Township earned second place in the PSA Campaign category from the Texas Association of Telecommunications Officers and Advisors (TATOA) for its profile of the Parks and Recreation Department, Branches of Impact. Selected from over 500 entries statewide, the video reflects the Township’s commitment to producing innovative, high-quality public communications.
* * *

# Accolades

### Gold Medal Awards
The Woodlands Township Parks and Recreation Department in Texas achieved significant recognition in 2025, winning the prestigious Texas Recreation and Parks Society (TRAPS) 2025 Texas Gold Medal Award. Additionally, the department was named a 2025 National Gold Medal Award Finalist by the National Recreation and Park Association (NRPA). Both awards honor excellence in parks and recreation, recognizing commitment to community engagement, long-range planning and environmental stewardship.

The Woodlands Township was named a Silver Level Bicycle Friendly Community by the League of American Bicyclists and is now the highest ranked bicycle friendly community in Texas by the League of American Bicyclists, after maintaining its bronze status since 2011.

texts.0:
At a time when many are looking for ways to strengthen their communities, local investments in better bicycling offer a path forward. Today, the League of American Bicyclists is proud to recognize 91 new and renewing Bicycle Friendly Communities (BFCs), along with eight honorable mentions, celebrating local efforts to make biking safer and more accessible for millions of Americans. From major metropolitan areas like Phoenix, AZ (population 1.6M), to small rural towns like Frazee, MN (population 1,316), this round demonstrates how prioritizing bicycling can create healthier, more vibrant communities in any size or setting.
“Bicycling is more than just a mode of transportation—it’s a powerful tool for building healthier communities, fostering sustainability, and connecting people,” said Bill Nesper, executive director of the League of American Bicyclists. “The cities, regions, and towns recognized in this round of Bicycle Friendly Community awards are leading the way by investing in infrastructure and programs that make biking an easier, safer, and more accessible choice. Their leadership demonstrates that supporting bicycling is an investment in a healthier future for everyone.”
When municipalities apply for an award from the Bicycle Friendly Community program, they fill out an extensive application which requires collaboration across city agencies and with local advocates and other partners. Based on the communities’ responses, the League determines if they deserve recognition and at which award level. Critically, a report card with feedback from the League’s expert reviewers offers next steps that each applicant community can take to improve how well they support people who bike in the future.
Leadership at both the state and local levels is pivotal in shaping if and how communities prioritize better bicycling. This round highlights the impact of that leadership, particularly in Washington state, the League’s #1 Bicycle Friendly State, which boasts seven new and renewing Bicycle Friendly Communities. Washington’s commitment to spreading the joy of bicycling has stood the test of time — for example, newly upgraded Silver-level BFC Anacortes has operated a free bikeshare program at its ferry port since 1997 and continues to promote cycling safety and fitness for all ages and abilities. Access to comprehensive bike education is a key contributing factor to Washington’s success as the top-ranking Bicycle Friendly State, and our feedback for several Bicycle Friendly Communities encourages them to take advantage of Cascade Bicycle Club’s incredible statewide cycling education program, if they aren’t already.
texts.1:
Washington’s leadership is inspiring progress (or perhaps healthy competition) in neighboring states as well. In Oregon, Eugene submitted an exceptionally strong renewal application, reaffirming its status as a Gold-level Bicycle Friendly Community. In Idaho, the capital city of Boise has set an example with a standout application highlighting the city’s ongoing efforts to improve bicycling for all. This year, Boise and surrounding Ada County both applied for higher award levels and both successfully earned Gold-level Bicycle Friendly Community status, demonstrating their shared commitment to creating safer, more accessible streets. Their efforts are strengthened by local partnerships with local groups such as Boise State University, a Platinum-level Bicycle Friendly University; the Boise Bicycle Project, a Platinum-level Bicycle Friendly Business; as well as public health agencies and many other partners, aligning transportation planning with broader community well-being goals.
**Case Study: Looking Ahead to Platinum**
Boise’s approach prioritizes safety, accessibility, and inclusive mobility. Both Boise and Ada County have adopted Vision Zero commitments and the Ada County Highway District (ACHD)’s Livable Streets Performance Measures ensure bike infrastructure is designed for people of all ages and abilities. The city’s Adaptive Recreation Program and Safe Routes to School initiatives expand cycling access, while Boise’s efforts to reduce speed limits have resulted in 76.81% of the city’s roads (over 1,100 miles) being set to 20 MPH or less.
Community input via our public survey plays a crucial role in the BFC evaluation process, helping to shape recommendations for future improvements. In addition to their feedback report card, all applicants receive a full report of their public survey results and this local input also informs the recommendations provided to each community on the League’s BFC report card. One highlight from Boise’s BFC public survey is a rising demand for improved maintenance practices on bike facilities, emphasizing the need not just to build infrastructure but to keep it safe and accessible year-round. With a growing network of low-speed streets, protected bike lanes, and a vibrant car-free downtown corridor, Boise’s new Gold-level status sets a strong example for active transportation in the Mountain West — and with improved maintenance practices, a Platinum BFC award could be on the horizon.
texts.2:
Along with Boise, this round features six other state capitals celebrating BFC status including renewing Bronze-level Nashville, Tennessee; newly Bronze-level Cheyenne, Wyoming; and Honolulu, Hawaii, which moved up to Silver-level status in this round after holding Bronze since 2014. Many of these communities show a commitment to improving active transportation as a way to make their residents happier, healthier, and better connected. In renewing Bronze-level Topeka, Kansas, “Ridership has visibly increased as a result of increased infrastructure and community investment in the active transportation culture.” Local leaders have forged local partnerships to pursue multi-modal transportation grants on behalf of the city and county, resulting in 28 new miles of on-street bike lanes and side paths being added to Topeka’s bikeways network since 2020.
Of the 91 communities being recognized in this announcement, 16 communities are moving up in award levels, 67 are renewing at the same level, and eight first-time applicants have earned Bronze on their first application. After all award status expirations and additions, there are now 460 recognized Bicycle Friendly Communities nationwide, with 76 million people living in a current BFC. From bustling cities to quiet countryside towns, these communities are leading the way in showing that investments in bicycling not only improve infrastructure but also the quality of life for everyone. As places across the nation step up to prioritize active transportation, the momentum for safer, more accessible biking at the local level continues to grow stronger.
To explore all the communities recognized in this round, see the full list of current and past Bicycle Friendly Communities here. Any community that would like to join, return to, or stay on the BFC list, can start their new or renewal application and submit by June 25, 2025 to be reviewed in the next round.
Apply to BFC program
**About the Bicycle Friendly Community℠ Program**
Bicycle Friendly Community awards reflect local leaders’ ongoing work to build better places to bike and evaluate those efforts as part of a national movement. Each of the five levels of the Bicycle Friendly University award – diamond, platinum, gold, silver, and bronze, plus an honorable mention category – provide a clear path for cities and towns to continuously improve. Visit bikeleague.org/community to learn more about the BFC program.
**About the League Of American Bicyclists**
texts.3: Since 1880, the League of American Bicyclists has been people-powered, with a goal to make bicycling safer and easier as a means of transportation and recreation. Today, the League continues to improve lives and strengthen communities through bicycling. We are more than 200,000 members and supporters strong with more than 1,000 state and local advocacy groups and bike clubs as well as thousands of businesses, universities, and communities together leading the movement to create a Bicycle Friendly America for everyone.

Title: 91 Places Earned Bicycle Friendly Community Awards in 2024
Chunks: 0,1,2,3
At a time when many are looking for ways to strengthen their communities, local investments in better bicycling offer a path forward. Today, the League of American Bicyclists is proud to recognize 91 new and renewing Bicycle Friendly Communities (BFCs), along with eight honorable mentions, celebrating local efforts to make biking safer and more accessible for millions of Americans. From major metropolitan areas like Phoenix, AZ (population 1.6M), to small rural towns like Frazee, MN (population 1,316), this round demonstrates how prioritizing bicycling can create healthier, more vibrant communities in any size or setting.
“Bicycling is more than just a mode of transportation—it’s a powerful tool for building healthier communities, fostering sustainability, and connecting people,” said Bill Nesper, executive director of the League of American Bicyclists. “The cities, regions, and towns recognized in this round of Bicycle Friendly Community awards are leading the way by investing in infrastructure and programs that make biking an easier, safer, and more accessible choice. Their leadership demonstrates that supporting bicycling is an investment in a healthier future for everyone.”
When municipalities apply for an award from the Bicycle Friendly Community program, they fill out an extensive application which requires collaboration across city agencies and with local advocates and other partners. Based on the communities’ responses, the League determines if they deserve recognition and at which award level. Critically, a report card with feedback from the League’s expert reviewers offers next steps that each applicant community can take to improve how well they support people who bike in the future.
Leadership at both the state and local levels is pivotal in shaping if and how communities prioritize better bicycling. This round highlights the impact of that leadership, particularly in Washington state, the League’s #1 Bicycle Friendly State, which boasts seven new and renewing Bicycle Friendly Communities. Washington’s commitment to spreading the joy of bicycling has stood the test of time — for example, newly upgraded Silver-level BFC Anacortes has operated a free bikeshare program at its ferry port since 1997 and continues to promote cycling safety and fitness for all ages and abilities. Access to comprehensive bike education is a key contributing factor to Washington’s success as the top-ranking Bicycle Friendly State, and our feedback for several Bicycle Friendly Communities encourages them to take advantage of Cascade Bicycle Club’s incredible statewide cycling education program, if they aren’t already.

Washington’s leadership is inspiring progress (or perhaps healthy competition) in neighboring states as well. In Oregon, Eugene submitted an exceptionally strong renewal application, reaffirming its status as a Gold-level Bicycle Friendly Community. In Idaho, the capital city of Boise has set an example with a standout application highlighting the city’s ongoing efforts to improve bicycling for all. This year, Boise and surrounding Ada County both applied for higher award levels and both successfully earned Gold-level Bicycle Friendly Community status, demonstrating their shared commitment to creating safer, more accessible streets. Their efforts are strengthened by local partnerships with local groups such as Boise State University, a Platinum-level Bicycle Friendly University; the Boise Bicycle Project, a Platinum-level Bicycle Friendly Business; as well as public health agencies and many other partners, aligning transportation planning with broader community well-being goals.
**Case Study: Looking Ahead to Platinum**
Boise’s approach prioritizes safety, accessibility, and inclusive mobility. Both Boise and Ada County have adopted Vision Zero commitments and the Ada County Highway District (ACHD)’s Livable Streets Performance Measures ensure bike infrastructure is designed for people of all ages and abilities. The city’s Adaptive Recreation Program and Safe Routes to School initiatives expand cycling access, while Boise’s efforts to reduce speed limits have resulted in 76.81% of the city’s roads (over 1,100 miles) being set to 20 MPH or less.
Community input via our public survey plays a crucial role in the BFC evaluation process, helping to shape recommendations for future improvements. In addition to their feedback report card, all applicants receive a full report of their public survey results and this local input also informs the recommendations provided to each community on the League’s BFC report card. One highlight from Boise’s BFC public survey is a rising demand for improved maintenance practices on bike facilities, emphasizing the need not just to build infrastructure but to keep it safe and accessible year-round. With a growing network of low-speed streets, protected bike lanes, and a vibrant car-free downtown corridor, Boise’s new Gold-level status sets a strong example for active transportation in the Mountain West — and with improved maintenance practices, a Platinum BFC award could be on the horizon.

Along with Boise, this round features six other state capitals celebrating BFC status including renewing Bronze-level Nashville, Tennessee; newly Bronze-level Cheyenne, Wyoming; and Honolulu, Hawaii, which moved up to Silver-level status in this round after holding Bronze since 2014. Many of these communities show a commitment to improving active transportation as a way to make their residents happier, healthier, and better connected. In renewing Bronze-level Topeka, Kansas, “Ridership has visibly increased as a result of increased infrastructure and community investment in the active transportation culture.” Local leaders have forged local partnerships to pursue multi-modal transportation grants on behalf of the city and county, resulting in 28 new miles of on-street bike lanes and side paths being added to Topeka’s bikeways network since 2020.
Of the 91 communities being recognized in this announcement, 16 communities are moving up in award levels, 67 are renewing at the same level, and eight first-time applicants have earned Bronze on their first application. After all award status expirations and additions, there are now 460 recognized Bicycle Friendly Communities nationwide, with 76 million people living in a current BFC. From bustling cities to quiet countryside towns, these communities are leading the way in showing that investments in bicycling not only improve infrastructure but also the quality of life for everyone. As places across the nation step up to prioritize active transportation, the momentum for safer, more accessible biking at the local level continues to grow stronger.
To explore all the communities recognized in this round, see the full list of current and past Bicycle Friendly Communities here. Any community that would like to join, return to, or stay on the BFC list, can start their new or renewal application and submit by June 25, 2025 to be reviewed in the next round.
Apply to BFC program
**About the Bicycle Friendly Community℠ Program**
Bicycle Friendly Community awards reflect local leaders’ ongoing work to build better places to bike and evaluate those efforts as part of a national movement. Each of the five levels of the Bicycle Friendly University award – diamond, platinum, gold, silver, and bronze, plus an honorable mention category – provide a clear path for cities and towns to continuously improve. Visit bikeleague.org/community to learn more about the BFC program.
**About the League Of American Bicyclists**

Since 1880, the League of American Bicyclists has been people-powered, with a goal to make bicycling safer and easier as a means of transportation and recreation. Today, the League continues to improve lives and strengthen communities through bicycling. We are more than 200,000 members and supporters strong with more than 1,000 state and local advocacy groups and bike clubs as well as thousands of businesses, universities, and communities together leading the movement to create a Bicycle Friendly America for everyone.

## 2025
### Certificate of Achievement for Excellence in Financial Reporting
The Government Finance Officer Association (GFOA) established the Certificate of Achievement for Excellence in Financial Reporting Program (COA) in 1945 to encourage and assist state and local governments to go beyond the minimum requirements of generally accepted accounting principles to prepare annual comprehensive financial reports that evidence the spirit of transparency and full disclosure and then to recognize individual governments that succeed in achieving that goal. The goal of the program is not to assess the financial health of participating governments, but rather to ensure that users of their financial statements have the information they need to do so themselves.

Approximately 1,800 governments, including states, cities, counties, special districts, school districts, and more have been recognized for transparency in budgeting.
